body: Land Use Committee - City Council Committee
name: Land Use Committee Meeting Agenda
agenda_text:
AGENDA
  Meeting of the City Council's
  LAND USE COMMITTEE
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  City Hall
  31200 Oak Crest Drive
  Westlake Village, CA 91361

  MONDAY, APRIL 22, 2024 – 3:30 p.m.
  .
  .

To provide Public Comments, you may attend in-person at City Hall or submit your written
comments via email to the City Clerk's Office (cityclerk@wlv.org) no later than 11:00 a.m. on the
meeting date. Written comments will be provided to Land Use Committee Members prior to the
meeting and posted at https://www.wlv.org/611/Council-Committee-Supplemental-Packets

In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related
modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or
services, please call the City Clerk’s office at (818) 706-1613 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

 Agenda and Staff Reports are posted on the City’s Website- Click on Public Meeting Agendas
 or www.wlv.org/agendacenter

 If any additional disclosable public records are distributed to the Committee Members less
 than 72 hours prior to the meeting, such materials are available in City Hall during normal
 business hours and are posted on the City’s Website -https://www.wlv.org/611/Council-
 Committee-Supplemental-Packets

 Signup for Agenda Posting Notifications for the Agenda Center. The Agenda Center is a
 central location for all public meeting agendas. You select the categories for your
 notifications.  Sign up using “Notify Me” on the Westlake Village home page or
 https://www.wlv.org/List.aspx
 CALL TO ORDER  3:30 p.m.

ROLL CALL:  Mayor Davis, Councilmember Pearl

PUBLIC COMMENTS:
Members of the public may address the Land Use Committee on items not on the printed agenda and within
the Council’s/Committee’s subject matter jurisdiction. Please observe the time limit of three minutes.

BUSINESS:

1.  Oak Tree Permit No. 24-001
  Applicant: Larry & Suzanne Stoops
  Project Address: 147 Sherwood Drive
  Project Description: Request to remove four protected oak trees that are growing
  in conflict with a residence and either currently causing damage or likely to cause
  damage in the future and prune one protected oak tree.

  2. Conditional Use Permit No. 14-007, Modification No. 3
  Applicant: Selleck Development Group dba The Shoppes at Westlake Village
  Project Address: 30770 Russell Ranch Road, Suite H
  Project Description: Request for a time extension of an approved Conditional Use
  Permit to authorize the continued operation of a gym.

  3. Planned Development Permit No. 24-001
  Applicant: Monica Casas
  Project Address: 32037 Kingspark Court
  Project Description: Request for a Planned Development Permit to authorize the
  conversion of 231 sq. ft. of non-habitable space to habitable space, the addition of
  831 sq. ft. of new habitable space, an interior and exterior remodel, and the
  installation of a new covered porch, loggia, and trellis.

  4. Discussion of Development Standard Revisions for ADUs
  Project Address: Residentially zoned properties
  Project Description: Discussion of provisions to regulate the development of
  accessory dwelling units between the front yard setback and a residence unless it
  would not permit the construction of an 800 sq. ft. unit.

ADJOURNMENT:

This agenda was posted on Wednesday, April 17 2024 at 4:00 p.m. on the City’s website and in
the Posting Board at City Hall.

  City Clerk
  April 17, 2024
